d:
The Supreme Court has cancelled the premature release of former MP Anand Mohan, convicted in the 1994 murder case of IAS officer G Krishnaiah. The court has directed Anand Mohan to surrender within one month.
The decision has triggered a political controversy in Bihar. RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav has targeted Nitish Kumar and the BJP, alleging political convenience behind Anand Mohan's release. RJD MP Misa Bharti has also questioned the government's intentions and suggested a political angle behind the latest development.
